Tersedia Private Mentoring dan Private Intensive untuk 1 peserta, serta Small Class untuk grup kecil dengan maksimal 5 peserta. Kelas dapat berlangsung offline atau online, menyesuaikan.
Private Mentoring and Private Intensive are available for 1 participant, while Small Class accommodates up to 5 participants. Classes can take place in person or online, as arranged.

Private Mentoring berdurasi total 2 jam, dibagi 1 jam per hari selama 2 hari atau selesai dalam 1 hari. Private Intensive berdurasi total 4 jam, dibagi 2 jam per hari selama 2 hari. Small Class berdurasi 4 jam.
Private Mentoring lasts 2 hours in total, split into 1 hour a day over 2 days or completed in 1 day. Private Intensive lasts 4 hours, split into 2 hours a day over 2 days. Small Class lasts 4 hours.
